title: lass leucantha
intro: Lass leucantha, commonly known as Mexican Sage, is a flowering plant species native to Mexico and parts of the southwestern United States. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and acting as an antiseptic to promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Lass leucantha include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which help to calm the nervous system and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Lass leucantha include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
